name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
moat_justification: RNAi platform leader with patent-protected GalNAc delivery, first-mover Amvuttra in ATTR cardiomyopathy backed by HELIOS-B mortality data, and quarterly subcutaneous dosing versus daily oral rivals; offset by three-front competition (Pfizer, BridgeBio, Ionis), heavy TTR franchise concentration, high SBC load, and payer/pricing pressure — strong moat, not wide.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.4%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.6% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Strong RNAi platform, moat 7/10, at an inflection to positive owner's earnings — but at $224.41 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 11.55%, weighted IV@15 $144.38); the price that clears 15% on these inputs is $144.38.
moat_for: Patent-protected RNAi/GalNAc delivery platform, repeatable across targets
Amvuttra first-mover in ATTR-CM with HELIOS-B mortality/CV-event data
Quarterly subcutaneous dosing vs daily oral competitors
Proven pricing power in rare disease (Givlaari, Oxlumo) plus TTR scale
Deep pipeline and Roche zilebesiran partnership extending the platform
moat_against: TTR franchise concentration — most growth rides on Amvuttra
Three-front competition: Pfizer Vyndaqel, BridgeBio acoramidis, Ionis
Patent expiry and payer pricing pressure on high-cost rare-disease drugs
Heavy SBC load and 3.4%/yr share dilution
Pipeline/binary trial risk beyond the liver franchise
